summary:
This bill is a resolution from Congress. It says Congress does not agree with a rule made by the Department of Labor. The rule was about how retirement plan managers should pick investments and vote as shareholders.

If this resolution becomes law, that Department of Labor rule would be canceled. It would have no power or effect. The rule was published in the Federal Register on December 1, 2022. The Federal Register is where the government announces new rules. The House of Representatives passed this resolution on February 28, 2023.
